response.justification: Strong overall match for a Senior Fullstack role: 13+ years of professional experience with a clear TypeScript/Node.js + React core (Optilyz, RIDE Capital, re:cinq), multi-language breadth (Java, C/C++, Swift, D, PHP), MongoDB/SQL, AWS CDK, Docker/Kubernetes, and a demonstrated testing/craftsmanship culture (TDD, pairing, CI/CD, authored a test runner and assertion library). The current role at re:cinq explicitly covers AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling, which directly matches one of the harder-to-source requirements. Gaps are mostly framework-specific (no Nest.js, no explicit Jest/Vitest/Playwright, minimal Kotlin) and are likely quick to close for an engineer at this level. Worth an interview, with technical probing on Nest.js, modern React testing, and relational data modeling.
strengths: Deep TypeScript/Node.js + React fullstack experience with cloud (AWS) and Kubernetes exposure
Direct AI-agent / MCP tooling experience, matching a rare stated requirement
Exceptional testing and engineering-practice pedigree (TDD, CI/CD, authored test frameworks, teaches workshops)
concerns: No Nest.js experience listed, and no explicit Jest/Vitest/Playwright mention
Significant career investment in niche D language; relational DB (PostgreSQL) depth unclear
Staff-level title and very broad, overlapping role history may misalign with a mid-senior IC scope

key_factors.factor: Missing Nest.js and named test frameworks
